status: frozen before any B1 outcome generation
study: Pilot 0 Localization B1: signal-specific correction benefit and moderation
scope: Test whether the causal correction benefit and especially its relationship with frozen I1 differ between the B0-v2-validated uncertainty and verified-error signals. B1 does not retest B0 manipulation validity and does not revise CARS.

lineage.I1: I1 = 1 - P(correct), unchanged from Runs 1/2 and A0
lineage.A0: I1 showed modest error-discrimination information but no demonstrated correction-susceptibility validity
lineage.B0_v1: failed manipulation check because the probability probe induced baseline copying
lineage.B0_v2: passed fresh manipulation validation under repaired conversational reconstruction
lineage.forecast_guardrail: prior forecast about B weakening is not part of the B1 hypothesis test or analysis rule

population.benchmark: pinned MMLU-Pro test snapshot used by Pilot 0
population.eligibility: retain only initially-wrong frozen prestates after the unchanged Pilot 0 pre-treatment procedure
population.freshness: exclude all prior Pilot 0 plumbing samples, Run 1, Run 2, B0-v1, and B0-v2 sampled tasks

invariants.outcome_V: 1 iff final answer equals objective MMLU-Pro key; otherwise 0
invariants.post_rng_policy: branch id fixes post-treatment stochastic stream; arm identity may change only signal text

interface.history_assistant: exact frozen raw_model_output containing original ANSWER and P_CORRECT
interface.new_user_message: exact signal status text followed by: Review your previous answer and revise if necessary. Return exactly one line: ANSWER: <one option letter>

signals.E0: Signal status: No new information is available about whether your previous answer is correct.
signals.EU: Signal status: There is unverified reason to doubt whether your previous answer is correct.
signals.EV: Signal status: It has been verified that your previous answer is incorrect.

assignment.assignment_unit: one cloned post-treatment branch within block
assignment.randomization_rule: balanced randomization within each frozen-prestate block; exactly 2 E0, 2 EU, and 2 EV branches

estimands.tail_definition: exact block-level bottom/top quarters of I1 using schema-v2 deterministic outcome-blind tie breaking
estimands.mu_s_t: mean final correctness V under signal s within tail t, where s in {E0,EU,EV} and t in {low,high}
estimands.primary_B_question: Does the I1 moderation of correction benefit differ between verified-error and uncertainty signals?
estimands.average_effect_U: mean(V|EU) - mean(V|E0) across all eligible blocks
estimands.average_effect_V: mean(V|EV) - mean(V|E0) across all eligible blocks
estimands.average_EV_minus_EU: mean(V|EV) - mean(V|EU) across all eligible blocks

analysis.primary_test: two-sided blocked randomization inference for Gamma_B
analysis.permutation_rule: shuffle the six observed arm labels only within each frozen-prestate block, preserving exact 2/2/2 arm counts
analysis.bootstrap_rule: resample whole blocks; for tail estimands resample within the already-selected low/high tail block sets
analysis.equivalence_rationale: chosen before B1 data and smaller than both absolute Run 1 and Run 2 observed moderation contrasts (~0.0515 and ~0.0333); used only to distinguish B weakened from B unresolved after a non-significant primary test
analysis.secondary_p_values: none; only the prespecified two-sided randomization p-value for Gamma_B is primary

interpretation_gate.B_GAINS_SUPPORT: primary two-sided randomization p-value for Gamma_B < 0.05
interpretation_gate.B_WEAKENS_AT_PRACTICAL_SCALE: primary p-value >= 0.05 and the 95% block-bootstrap interval for Gamma_B lies entirely inside [-0.025,+0.025]
interpretation_gate.B_UNRESOLVED: all other outcomes, including a non-significant primary test with a bootstrap interval not contained inside the equivalence region
interpretation_gate.average_effect_guardrail: different average correction effects across signals do not by themselves establish B; B concerns differential I1 moderation
interpretation_gate.C_guardrail: B weakening exposes C but does not confirm C; B unresolved gives C no additional authority
interpretation_gate.B0_guardrail: B1 outcome data are not used to retroactively validate or invalidate B0-v2 manipulation validity

forbidden_updates_before_data: promote C based on a null p-value alone
use B0 confidence shifts as B1 outcomes
